mapper.select:
select a.id as id, 'INDIRECT' as financing_Type, base.id as financing_id, base.financing_code as financing_code, IFNULL(plan.financing_amount, 0) as financing_amount, a.account_id as account_id, a.account_origin_id as account_origin_id, a.account_category as account_category, a.account_bank as account_bank, a.account_number as account_number, a.account_type as account_type, a.simulate_settle as simulate_settle, a.settle_time as settle_time, a.settle_amount as settle_amount, base.fund_manager_id as fund_manager, bu.user_name as fund_manager_name, null as product_name from fund_financing_account_setting a left join fund_financing_base_info base on base.id = a.financing_id and a.financing_type is null left join fund_financing_plan plan on plan.financing_id = base.id left join bifrost_user bu ON base.fund_manager_id = bu.id where 1 = 1 and base.financing_status = 'CARRY_INTEREST' and a.deleted = 0
and base.financing_code like concat('%', #{financingCode}, '%')
AND base.id in ( select financing_id from fund_financing_credit_ref where organization_id in (select id from fund_organization where organization_name like CONCAT('%', #{organizationName}, '%')) )
and a.simulate_settle = #{simulateSettle}
and a.account_bank like concat('%', #{accountBank}, '%')
and a.account_number like concat('%', #{accountNumber}, '%')
union all(
select a.id as id, 'DIRECT' as financing_Type, base.id as financing_id, base.financing_code as financing_code, IFNULL(base.financing_amount, 0) * 10000 as financing_amount, a.account_id as account_id, a.account_origin_id as account_origin_id, a.account_category as account_category, a.account_bank as account_bank, a.account_number as account_number, a.account_type as account_type, a.simulate_settle as simulate_settle, a.settle_time as settle_time, a.settle_amount as settle_amount, base.fund_manager_id as fund_manager, bu.user_name as fund_manager_name, base.product_name as product_name from fund_financing_account_setting a left join fund_direct_financing_base_info base on base.id = a.financing_id and a.financing_type = 'DIRECT' left join bifrost_user bu ON base.fund_manager_id = bu.id where 1 = 1 and base.financing_status = 'CARRY_INTEREST' and a.deleted = 0
and base.financing_code like concat('%', #{financingCode}, '%')
and base.product_name like concat('%', #{organizationName}, '%')
and a.simulate_settle = #{simulateSettle}
and a.account_bank like concat('%', #{accountBank}, '%')
and a.account_number like concat('%', #{accountNumber}, '%')
)
